title: rust/lichen-core/src/lib.rs: Test assertions use wrong upper bound for channel range
description: Multiple test assertions use `< n_channels` instead of `<= n_channels`. The channel formula `1 + (hash % N)` produces values 1 through N inclusive. Lines 279, 280, 288, 289, 345, 375, 376, 392, 393 would incorrectly reject valid maximum channel values. Tests pass only because current hash inputs happen to avoid the edge case.
